base colour sRGB with baked blood (Outfit)
base colour sRGB with baked blood (Gear)

shared_textures: N / ORM (and hair masks, eyes) are the base character's maps under PhotorealPass/Characters/Dink/Textures
companion_decal: Unclaimed/blood_splat/Blood_Pool_02 (2.2 m), centred under the body; the render shows it
dresses: Dink lying dead on his back (the cutscene pose), arms out, blood under him
status: source delivered; not imported into Unreal, not bound to any placement
known_weaknesses: A posed copy of SK_Dink_Photoreal (its LOD2, about 17903 triangles) with the pose applied: no ragdoll, no wounds cut into the mesh, eyes open as in the base, clothes not draped by simulation (the skirt and limbs are flattened towards the ground by rule). Blood is baked into copies of the base-colour maps from one 3D mask: it does not change roughness or normal, so soaked cloth is not glossy. The pool under the body is the separate decal named in `companion_decal`. Normal and ORM maps are the base character's. One convex hull is exported; corpses are visual only in the game.
